Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tooling and overall QE processes .

3-5 years or equivalent experience in UI automation for web applications
Solid experience writing automated tests in Python, JavaScript, C ++ or any other Programming Language
Experience with Selenium or Appium or UI Automation technologies
Knowledge and experience testing APIs (RESTful), Libraries, SDK/Application Frameworks, Native Applications
Experience with at least one modern web application framework
Strong technical, analytical and problem-solving skills
Able to work efficiently as part of a team and independently
Strong initiative and outstanding verbal and written communication skills
Bonus Qualifications:
Experience developing or writing test code/scripting for a game console
Experience developing an application (game application is extra bonus)
Practical experience using development and deployment tools: Git, Jenkins, Docker
Experience using source control (esp. Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins or Circle CI)

We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
The Marketing Enablement & Technology (MET) team sits within Instacart's Marketing organization, building the systems, data pipelines, and platforms that power how Instacart markets, measures, and grows. Operating at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Engineering, we own the platforms behind organic search visibility, campaign feeds, audience targeting, event pipelines, and QA automation.
We're seeking a Software Engineer II who will build across two of our highest-leverage growth surfaces: Technical Search Visibility (SEO) and CRM Enablement. On the SEO side, you'll ship full-stack features that improve Instacart's search engine and AI answer engine visibility across millions of web pages and drive organic traffic. On the CRM side, you'll build and evolve the componentized email system and execution tooling that gets lifecycle campaigns from brief to send across email, push, SMS, and in-app. You'll own features from build through rollout, contribute to technical decisions, and partner closely with Marketing and Product to turn growth requirements into scalable, testable customer experiences.
This is a hands-on role that spans both pods. You'll move between organic-traffic engineering and CRM execution tooling, so we're looking for someone who's comfortable being a full-stack generalist and going deep in whichever surface the work calls for.
About the Job
Design, build, and ship high-quality full-stack features that enhance search engine visibility, AI answer engine performance, and organic traffic, with a strong sense of urgency and ownership.
Build and evolve a modular React email component library that compiles to secure, client-safe HTML with simple, reusable abstractions.
Develop responsive, accessible HTML/CSS emails that render consistently across clients, devices, and dark mode, and enhance our Next.js compilation pipeline (preview, compile, validate, export) for speed, reliability, and observability.
Contribute to data pipelines for SEO and AEO ingestion, transformation, and delivery, keeping the system healthy as it grows.
Own execution of dynamic CRM campaigns (email, push, in-app) using structured blocks, templating languages, and JSON/YAML config, integrating with ESPs like Braze and REST APIs/webhooks for personalization and targeting with secure data handling.
Build automation and internal tooling that cuts QA and setup time across both surfaces, from SEO experimentation to CRM deep-link and token coverage.
Apply technical best practices to deliver performant, observable, and cost-aware code that improves search rankings, LLM visibility, campaign rendering fidelity, and user experience.
Troubleshoot rendering and logic issues across devices and states, leading triage, root-cause analysis, and system-level fixes.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and marketing partners to translate user needs into technical requirements, surface trade-offs, and deliver on shared goals.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
3-5 years of software engineering experience with proficiency in React, TypeScript, Ruby, Python, PostgreSQL, and SQL.
Demonstrated ability to build and launch complete full-stack features with minimal oversight, from development through experimentation and production rollout.
Hands-on use of React and Next.js to componentize UI and email and compile to production HTML with scalable abstractions.
Expertise in HTML/CSS and responsive email development, with strong rendering fidelity, performance, and accessibility across clients, devices, and dark mode.
Experience with distributed systems and data engineering, designing pipelines, optimizing schemas, and ensuring data quality, with exposure to Airflow or dbt.
Comfort building and testing REST API integrations (JSON, webhooks) for personalization and orchestration, including hands-on API testing and validation, with secure, privacy-compliant data handling.
Ability to write performant code and improve observability through logging and metrics, identifying and resolving bottlenecks as they arise.
Strong product mindset with the ability to translate user needs into technical requirements and understand how your work impacts business metrics.
Effective communicator who can collaborate across marketing, product, creative, and engineering partners to align on requirements and deliver solutions.
Systems mindset: you improve the whole ecosystem you work in, leave code and docs better than you found them, and surface technical debt proactively
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SEO/AEO initiatives or familiarity with SEO best practices, answer engine optimization for LLMs, structured data (Schema.org), search engine crawling and indexing, and Core Web Vitals.
Familiarity with how AI-powered search engines and LLMs consume and surface content, with curiosity about optimizing for AI answer generation.
Familiarity with templating and personalization languages (e.g., Liquid, AMPscript) and ESP platforms such as Braze or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience with QA tools and workflows for email testing (e.g., Litmus, Email on Acid) and link/UTM validation.
Testing experience with Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress/Playwright.
Experience with big data technologies (Apache Spark, Hadoop), NoSQL databases, and data warehousing platforms (Snowflake, Redshift).
Experience building design systems or shared component libraries for marketing surfaces.
Track record of launching experiments and analyzing results, including A/B testing frameworks for measuring SEO/AEO or CRM impact.
Experience implementing solutions that leverage AI to enhance developer or marketer workflows.
Previous experience partnering with marketing teams on growth initiatives in fast-paced environments.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu
The Data Analyst position will play a pivotal role on the PEO Analytics team, leveraging operational performance data to diagnose fulfillment quality gaps, spearhead the detection and resolution of quality issues, and deliver data-driven recommendations that improve Instacart's products and processes. This means not only tackling immediate escalations but also establishing proactive monitoring systems that enhance long-term operational excellence, as well as supporting cross-functional insight needs that drive improvements across multiple areas of the business.
The Platform Excellence Operations (PEO) team is dedicated to improving the quality of Instacart's online grocery experience for customers, shoppers, retailers, and the overall marketplace. The analytics team identifies, understands, and eliminates defects in that experience by analyzing and interpreting operational data, ensuring stakeholders have a consistent understanding of why business performance is changing and advocating for improvements that might otherwise be overlooked.
As part of the Marketplace and Retailer Pillar within PEO Analytics, this role works on fulfillment quality problems ranging from cancellations and reschedules to timeliness, and plays an essential role in maintaining Instacart's reputation for reliability and operational excellence, from metrics analysis to strategy development. You will be part of a dynamic, cross-functional team whose success is built on transparency, communication, and the relentless pursuit of solutions that “Grow the Pie” for all stakeholders involved.
What you'll cook up in your first year
Metrics and Reporting
Retailer performance issues are proactively monitored and resolved across broad dimensions, with dashboards and processes built to simplify problem diagnosis and support new retailer launches.
Performance fluctuations and outliers in key Retailer Quality workstream metrics are tracked and analyzed to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
Data Analysis
Large datasets related to Retailer Fulfillment Quality are analyzed to derive business insights, with analytical plans independently created and executed to identify, understand, and reduce fulfillment quality issues with high accuracy and consistency.
Analytics requests, ad hoc retailer analyses, launch impact assessments, and retailer escalations are supported, with initiative sizing provided for product and analytical roadmaps.
Presentations and Communication
Insights decks are created and presented regularly to a cross-functional audience of business and technical stakeholders, with findings framed as clear logical narratives backed by data that result in actionable recommendations.
The secret ingredients we're looking for
Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)
1+ years of experience in a data analytics-related role such as business intelligence, corporate strategy, consulting, or data science.
Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis.
Ability to aggregate and synthesize large amounts of data, leveraging a deep understanding of micro and macro fulfillment metrics and systems to drive insights.
Strong problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail; able to quickly detect anomalies in performance metrics and trends, form hypotheses for investigation, and draw conclusions through nuanced analysis.
Proficiency in PowerPoint or Google Slides for effective communication.
Ability to work independently with a strong sense of ownership and comfort proposing new ideas to challenge existing processes.
Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)
Experience working in a consumer marketplace or logistics business.
Familiarity with Snowflake or similar data warehouses, GitHub, and Jira.
Experience with visualization tools such as Mode or Tableau.
Experience working directly with product and engineering teams on scalable process solutions.
Experience with using AI tools for analytics, including applying methods for data validation and reproducibility
